effective_or_revised: Original Effective Date 09/15/12; Reviewed 05/28/26; Revised 06/15/26 (committee approval 05/28/26)

Navigation bar (Position Statement / Billing/Coding / Reimbursement / Program Exceptions / Definitions / Related Guidelines / Other / References / Updates)
criteria_location: There are no criteria. The whole coverage rule is one sentence in POSITION STATEMENT (p.2). DESCRIPTION holds a 'Summary and Analysis of Evidence' paragraph that explains why, but it is evidence, not criteria.
procedures_covered: Subtalar arthroereisis (sinus tarsi implant insertion, removal, removal and reinsertion) - all investigational

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: None. The single statement is a blanket exclusion.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Not addressed; removal and reinsertion codes are listed as Investigational too.

requirement_kinds.quote: Subtalar arthroereisis is considered experimental or investigational for all indications.

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: No criteria to tie to. Each code carries an inline '(Investigational)' tag: '0335T Insertion of sinus tarsi implant (Investigational)'.

external_dependencies.what: FEP and SAO members are sent to their own guidelines; Medicare Advantage notes no NCD/LCD found
external_dependencies.quote: Federal Employee Program (FEP): Follow FEP guidelines.

vague_terms.quote: The evidence is insufficient to determine the effects of the technology on health outcomes.
vague_terms.problem: Boilerplate rationale, not a testable condition.

extraction_hazards: Navigation bar (Position Statement / Billing/Coding / ... / Updates) is flattened into three text lines between the disclaimer and DESCRIPTION.
Disclaimer wraps mid-sentence and is all caps, easy to mistake for content.
Update-history table: from 06/15/22 onward the dates lose their indent (lines 198-203), so the table looks irregular.
REFERENCES run 30 items and occupy half the file; nothing there is criteria.
interesting_structures: Pure 'investigational for all indications' policy: the entire tree is a single NOT-covered leaf. Update history repeats 'Position statement maintained' every year, showing the stance has been frozen since 2012.
'Reimbursement Information' just says 'Refer to section entitled POSITION STATEMENT.'

fit_to_tree.why: Nothing to evaluate: always not covered. The checker should return a fixed 'not medically necessary / investigational' result, not a tree.
